title: PRIVARY Secure Photo Vault
summary: True Privacy Protection. Hide photos, videos & documents in your Private Vault.
description:
Secure your most private photos, videos, and documents with Privary Photo Vault, trusted by over 8 million users worldwide and already locked multi-million files. Our app safeguards your data with the same encryption standards used by governments, ensuring the highest level of protection.

Feel the difference with Privary
Privary's intuitive interface makes it easier than ever to organize and protect your files.
Sort your photos, keep them private and protect any video or document in your locked Vault. Privary is a Real Secure locking tool that hides all personal documents with unique full-protection.

Multi-Level Security for Unbreakable Protection
Unlike other apps that simply hide files, Privary Photo Vault utilizes robust AES CTR encryption to protect your data from hackers and prying eyes. Our advanced security measures guarantee the privacy of your most sensitive content.

📱 Hide and lock documents, photos and videos
🔑 Open your Vault with PIN, Password, Face-Recognition or Fingerprint
🛡️ Sort your files with folders and sub-folders

Your Privacy - Our Priority
Import any photo, video, or document into Privary Gallery Lock and rest assured that it will remain encrypted and safe on your device. We never store or access your files, giving you complete control over your privacy.

Privary App Lock serves you with exclusive First Class Premium Protection:

• Full sd-card support
• Detect intruders automatically
• Not visible in the recently used apps

You may want to disguise Privary from your apps list. Or open a decoy Fake Vault to stay protected when someone forces you to open your Private Vault.

We ❤ Privacy.
Just import any photo, video or document to your Privary Photo Vault and be safe for whatever happens to your phone.

Personalize Privary with Premium Protection
• Ad-Free: Enjoy Best Protection without interruptions
• Fake Vault: Create a Decoy Vault with a separate password
• Cloud Protection: Take instant backups to your private secure Cloud

Common Privacy Concerns, Answered.

* Is Privary truly secure? Yes, Privary encrypts every file, not just your password, ensuring unbreakable protection.
* Does Privary send my files to a server? No, all files remain encrypted on your device or in your own Google Drive, if you choose to use the cloud.
* Can I access my files outside of Privary? Yes, you can easily export any file from your Private Vault. Anytime.

Protect Your Privacy Today

Download Privary Photo Vault and experience the peace of mind that comes with knowing your most private data is safe and secure. Our app empowers you to take control of your privacy and safeguard your sensitive information from prying eyes.

* What's the capacity of my Privary hidden folder?
Privary can lock down unlimited documents, photos and videos.
It is also the best choice if you look for a locker app to keep your messenger photos private.

* Is video playback supported?
Yes. Privary can play all videos. For example: mp4, wmv, mkv, avi, mov, 3gp, mpg, flv, h264, divx, ogv, f4v, m4v, dv etc.

Any questions on your Privary Photo Vault?
Just reach us at support@privary.me

❤ Privary takes care about your privacy. We focus on true protection for everyone in the world.
Install Privary and protect your personal documents just as strong as IT-Experts.
